Are you unknowingly losing money with your investments? In this video, we break down the 5 biggest investing mistakes that both beginners and seasoned investors make — and more importantly, how to avoid them.

Whether you're just getting started or already building your portfolio, avoiding these mistakes could save you thousands of dollars and years of regret.

What you’ll learn in this video:

Why panic selling during market drops can be disastrous

The truth about timing the market (spoiler: it doesn’t work)

How lack of diversification exposes you to huge risk

How fees quietly eat your profits over time

Why investing without a clear plan is a recipe for disaster

Plus, we share smart fixes and simple strategies you can start using today to build a stronger, more resilient portfolio.

Start investing smarter — not harder.

snippet.title: Live Well For Less: 10 Money Tips to Stop Overpaying
snippet.description:
Do you ever feel like “living well” means spending more than you actually have? This is how I flipped that narrative- learn how to live well for less—I found a daily rhythm that feels good, looks good, and costs way less.

Between social pressure, sneaky spending, and just trying to keep up with life, it’s easy to believe that comfort and joy come with a high price tag. But what if the secret to a richer life isn’t in your income—but your daily habits?

In this video, I’m sharing the 10 small but powerful habits that help me live well for less—without guilt, overwhelm, or endless budgeting spreadsheets. These aren’t just money-saving hacks. They’re life upgrades rooted in intention, simplicity, and joy.

Whether you’re working with a tight budget, trying to stop impulse spending, or just want to feel more content with what you already have, these habits are for you.

What You’ll Learn:
• 10 daily habits to help you live well for less
• How to feel abundant without overspending
• Mindset shifts that reduce lifestyle FOMO
• Easy ways to upgrade your day without the price tag
• How to build a life that’s rich in meaning, not just stuff

You don’t need a bigger paycheck to live a better life—you need a better plan. If you’re ready to feel calmer, more in control, and happier with your money, this is where it starts.

snippet.description:

- Create and stick to a practical budget.

- Stay committed and adjust your plan as needed.

Do you ever feel like saving money on food means eating boring meals or giving up everything you actually enjoy? Same. But then I realised—I didn’t need to change what I eat, just how I shop for it. This is how I started making small, intentional swaps at the supermarket that cut my grocery bill without cutting joy. These aren’t just budget tips—they’re practical food shifts that helped me save money every single week, while still eating well.

Between rising food prices, lifestyle pressure, and trying to keep it all together, it’s easy to feel stuck. But what if the answer isn’t a strict budget—it’s a smarter approach to grocery shopping? 

In this video, I’m sharing 15 simple grocery swaps that make a real difference. From pantry staples to snacks and fresh produce, these are the swaps I actually use to reduce waste, avoid impulse buys, and stretch my food budget—without feeling like I’m missing out.

Whether you’re meal planning on a budget, saving for something big, or just want to feel less stress at checkout, this one’s for you.

snippet.title: how to actually be so productive it feels dangerous
snippet.description:
If you want to build your own productivity system instead of duct‑taping more tools together, you can start with Emergent here:
https://app.emergent.sh/?utm_shift=redirect&via=gabe


the full prompt 
Build "Daily Driver" — a personal 12-Week-Year productivity app.
Single user, no monetization, no social features.

STACK: Expo + React Native (Expo Router) frontend that runs on iOS, Android,
AND web. FastAPI backend with /api prefix. MongoDB. Claude Sonnet 4.5 for AI.
Simple email+password auth with JWT.

DESIGN: Dark mode only. Pure black bg (#050505), muted gold accent (#D4AF37),
thin/light fonts, uppercase letter-spaced section labels. On web, cap content
at 720px and center it (dashboard-style).

ONBOARDING (4 steps): pick 90-day block start date → enter 1-3 SMART goals →
pick 1 keystone habit (e.g. "No phone till 9am") → Claude breaks each goal
into 12 weekly milestones + daily actions.

HOME SCREEN (top to bottom):
  1. Date header: "SATURDAY · WEEK 6 OF 12"
  2. Weekly review CTA banner (only on Sat/Sun if not submitted)
  3. KEYSTONE HABIT card with tap-to-complete + day-streak count
  4. PRIMARY TASK — 1 big card, subtitle "The one thing that moves the
     needle today", tap circle to toggle complete (strikethrough, STAYS visible)
  5. SECONDARY TASKS (2-3, de-emphasized until primary done): some auto-pulled
     from the goal breakdown, plus an inline "+ Add a secondary task" input
     for user-typed ones
  6. ADDITIONAL TASKS (open list, up to 5, free-form add)
  7. 90-day progress bar (small, at the bottom)
  8. "Open weekly review" link

KEY UX RULES:
- Completed tasks stay visible with strikethrough, they don't disappear
- Snapshot today's plan once per day so task IDs stay stable
- Tap = idempotent toggle

GOALS TAB: list all goals with progress bar. Tap to expand → 12 weeks with
done/total count, "WEEK N · CURRENT" gold badge for active week, past weeks
dimmed. Tap a week to see its actions — each has a checkbox AND a "+ TODAY"
button that makes it your primary action.

NOTES TAB: one free-text note per date, auto-save, simple journal list.

WEEKLY REVIEW (/weekly-review, auto-prompted Sat/Sun):
- Stats: tasks-completed this week, habit-days/7
- 3 prompts: "What worked?" / "What didn't?" / "How will you improve?"
- Cleaning-up checklist (update progress, organize notes, migrate tasks)
- Submit → Claude generates a 2-paragraph warm personal review
- Past reviews listed below for scroll-back

SKIP: Stripe, Google OAuth, social/follow, push notifications,
calendar sync, store publishing. Run via Expo Go + a web URL.

DB: users, goals (with breakdown.weeks[]), habits, task_completions,
habit_completions, daily_plans (snapshot), misc_tasks (with slot field),
notes (date-keyed), weekly_reviews (with ai_summary).

90 Day Goal Journal https://gabebult.co/Journal

I Want More by KALEO, https://t.lickd.co/l/A5KXvrxPQWB
